analytics.name: Analytic 1148
analytics.guidance: Monitor DNS queries, proxy logs, and user-agent strings for anomalous patterns associated with adversary attempts to hide infrastructure. Defenders may observe DNS resolutions to short-lived domains, abnormal WHOIS registration data, or filtering of known defensive/responder IP addresses.

tuning.description: List of domains registered with privacy-protected or suspicious WHOIS metadata.
Known incident response or scanning infrastructure IP ranges.

log_sources.name: dns:query
log_sources.channel: Excessive lookups for domains with suspicious WHOIS or short TTL values

analytics.name: Analytic 1149
analytics.guidance: Detect adversaries filtering traffic or modifying server responses to evade scanning. Monitor iptables, nftables, or proxy configurations that deny or redirect requests from known scanning agents or defensive tools.

tuning.description: User-agent strings or scanning tools to monitor for selective filtering.

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: execve: Execution of commands modifying iptables/nftables to block selective IPs

log_sources.name: NSM:Flow
log_sources.channel: Altered response metadata or blocked content based on user-agent or geolocation

analytics.name: Analytic 1150
analytics.guidance: Monitor unified logs for manipulation of proxy configurations, DNS resolution, or filtering rules. Adversaries may redirect responses or use trusted domains that later resolve to malicious C2 infrastructure.

tuning.description: Known hosting/CDN providers often abused to hide malicious C2 infrastructure.

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: System process modifications altering DNS/proxy settings

log_sources.name: NSM:Flow
log_sources.channel: Suspicious changes in TLS certificate responses or redirected domains

analytics.name: Analytic 1151
analytics.guidance: Inspect network telemetry for adversary attempts to blend malicious traffic with legitimate flows using VPNs, proxies, or geolocation spoofing. Defensive teams may observe anomalous tunnels, encrypted sessions to suspicious domains, or geo-mismatched IP activity.

tuning.description: Regions to monitor for unexpected or mismatched geolocation activity.

log_sources.name: NSM:Flow
log_sources.channel: Encrypted tunnels or proxy traffic to non-standard destinations

analytics.name: Analytic 1152
analytics.guidance: Monitor VM-level DNS and network traffic logs for adversary-controlled domains or selective response behavior (e.g., dropped requests from security scanners).

tuning.description: Targeted virtual machines where adversaries may attempt to hide C2 traffic.

log_sources.name: esxi:vmkernel
log_sources.channel: DNS lookups resolving to domains with rapid changes in registration metadata

log_sources.name: esxi:vmkernel
log_sources.channel: Suspicious traffic filtered or redirected by VM networking stack
